metadata.title: Use and handoff

applicability.scope: Classifying an inference engineering request and identifying reusable procedures.
applicability.input_contract: Goal, deliverable, known model, backend, OS, engine and workload constraints.
applicability.produced_artifact: Selected task cards, scoped references, unknowns and acceptance evidence.
applicability.refusal_point: If the execution owner, reference behavior or target compatibility is unknown, record the gap before making a target-specific recommendation.

limitations: The cards describe routes and acceptance evidence; hardware support and task success require separate validation.
